title: HELIX Bridge: PeopleSoft Fund → Fund

source_objects.description: Fund code table: SETID, FUND_CODE, EFFDT, DESCR, FUND_TYPE, EFF_STATUS. Effective-dated.
Fund hierarchy: parent-child for roll-up reporting (e.g., all restricted funds roll up to 'Restricted').
Fund type definitions: FUND_TYPE, DESCR. E.g., 'UR' = Unrestricted, 'RE' = Restricted, 'EN' = Endowment, 'PL' = Plant, 'AG' = Agency.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Map PS fund type to HELIX fund categories: 'UR' → 'unrestricted_general', 'DG' → 'unrestricted_designated', 'AX' → 'auxiliary', 'RF' → 'restricted_federal', 'RS' → 'restricted_state', 'RP' → 'restricted_private', 'ET' → 'endowment_true', 'EQ' → 'endowment_quasi', 'PU' → 'plant_unexpended', 'PR' → 'plant_renewal', 'PD' → 'plant_debt', 'SA' → 'student_aid', 'AG' → 'agency'. Actual codes are institution-specific — this is the mapping pattern.
For GASB: fund type drives restriction. For FASB: 'Without Donor Restrictions' → 'unrestricted', 'With Donor Restrictions' → 'restricted'.
Resolve parent fund from the tree for roll-up.
For public (GASB) institutions: 'Current Unrestricted', 'Current Restricted', 'Loan', 'Endowment', 'Plant', 'Agency'. Maps to GASB fund types for Statement of Net Position.

notes: Fund accounting is the cornerstone of higher ed finance. PS_FUND_TBL is effective-dated — always join on max EFFDT. The FUND_TYPE codes are institution-configurable, so the mapping pattern matters more than the specific code values. Public (GASB) institutions report by fund type on the Statement of Net Position; private (FASB) institutions report by restriction class (with/without donor restrictions) per ASU 2016-14.
